title: BPP mandate_prepare request (DESIGN.md §10.1, §14.8; registry R15 participant)
description: Mutation (meta required). Server-prepares one exact Mandate proposal from the caller's typed scope (§10.1: Mandates are server-prepared from exact proposals — a caller cannot obtain approval for an arbitrary digest and later attach a different action). Actor: proposed grantee or authorized issuer in its scope (R15); issuer_ref is channel-derived when the authorized issuer prepares and is named only when the proposed grantee prepares — gap note G30. mandate_id, revision, decision_refs, root_authority_trace_digest, dependency_set_ref, and issued_at are server-derived. Selector arrays are identifier arrays referencing selector definitions and manifestation_selector is an opaque BPA-1 body pending ADR-0001 — gap notes G10/G31. 'prepared' is the folded pre-issue state of the §14.8 Mandate row — gap note G30. Stage-capable (R15).

issuer_ref.description: Named only when the proposed grantee prepares; the channel-derived actor can never be overridden (§14.3) — gap note G30.

allowed_operations.description: Versioned BPP operation ids (§10.5 operation atoms).

resource_selectors.description: Identifier array referencing selector definitions (gap notes G10/G31).

data_class_selectors.description: Identifier array referencing selector definitions (gap notes G10/G31).

destination_selectors.description: Identifier array referencing selector definitions (gap notes G10/G31).

manifestation_selector.description: Opaque body pending the BPA-1 policy-algebra slice (ADR-0001); gap note G10.

pledge_ref.description: Optional Pledge lineage the purpose binds to (§10.2).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

class.description: Digest class per the §14.2 table; substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_id.description: Key id for keyed classes (raw HMAC keys and per-object salts are never part of a DigestRef).

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef (§14.2): every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; update operations additionally supply expected_revision (registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here).

grantee_selectors.description: Identifier array referencing selector definitions (gap note G10/G31).

delegation.description: Verbatim §10.1 delegation ceiling; a child Mandate can never exceed it (§10.2).
